| Method | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `closeWorldScreen()` | Closes the world select screen |
| `getAccountStatus()` | Gets the account status, only used to determine locked vs banned in login screen. |
| `getExistingUserButton()` | Gets the "Existing user" button rectangle |
| `getIndex()` | Gets the current login index of the game. |
| `getLoginEmail()` | Deprecated. |
| `getLoginPassword()` | Gets the currently typed text in the password field of the login screen. |
| `getResponse()` | Gets the current login response of the login screen, based on the response text in the login screen. |
| `isEnterToLogin()` | See setEnterToLogin |
| `isEscToCancel()` | see setEscToCancel(boolean) |
| `isWorldScreenOpen()` | Checks if the world select screen is open |
| `login()` | Logs in to the client with the currently set Account |
| `login(String email, String password)` | Logs in to the client with the given email and password |
| `login(org.dreambot.core.Account account)` | Logs in to the client with the given Account |
| `setEnterToLogin(boolean b)` | At the login screen you can hit enter instead of clicking the login button to open up the email/password interface This sets a boolean to true/false as to whether or not to use enter instead of clicking. |
| `setEscToCancel(boolean b)` | At the login screen you can hit escape instead of clicking the cancel button |
